verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a changelog note that Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data to keep it longer than Honeybadger stores it. That implies a fixed vendor retention window, with a tier-gated workaround to extend retention through your own copy. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods inside Honeybadger, any documented deletion controls (per-error, per-project or account-level purge), API/MCP-driven deletion, and independent corroboration.
